pages.en: Lily's class is doing a project about animals. Lily and Mia want to learn about penguins, so they go to the school library.
pages.zh: Lily 的班级在做一个关于动物的课题。Lily 和 Mia 想了解企鹅，于是她们去了学校图书馆。
pages.scene: Lily and her classmate Mia in a cosy school library pulling a big book about penguins off a bookshelf.

pages.en: They find a big book with lots of information. Penguins can't fly, but they can swim very fast. Mia draws a penguin and Lily writes the notes.
pages.zh: 她们找到一本有很多资料的大书。企鹅不会飞，但游得非常快。Mia 画了一只企鹅，Lily 做笔记。
pages.scene: Lily and Mia at a library table, a big open book with pictures of penguins swimming, Mia drawing a penguin and Lily writing notes, no readable writing.

pages.en: On Thursday, they show their project to the class. Everyone likes the penguin picture. "Very good work!" says the teacher.
pages.zh: 星期四，她们向全班展示课题。大家都喜欢那幅企鹅画。“做得非常好！”老师说。
pages.scene: Lily and Mia standing at the front of the classroom holding up a big colourful poster with a penguin drawing, classmates clapping, the teacher smiling, no writing.

questions.zh: 这个课题是关于企鹅的。

questions.q: Where do Lily and Mia find the book?
questions.zh: Lily 和 Mia 在哪里找到那本书？
